notes: LOW CONFIDENCE: Picton, Ferrie, Simcoe on Wellington are collinear; only Ferrie & Victoria lies off that line, so cross-axis scale rests on one point. Burton & Victoria rejected (modern Burton node ~19 m north of the 1898 Burton). Victoria centre estimated as west curb + half the Wellington width (east curb is in the binding). Picton centre estimated from south curb (north curb cut off). Strachan & Wellington no longer exists; bottom crop at Strachan centre on the left, but Sawyer-Massey works continue south to ~y 7700 (see sheet 33).
